\section{The SM--spacetime loaded Renewal Grand Tensor}
\label{sec:SMST-loaded}
% =============================================================================

\subsection{What the operationally complete Grand Tensor gives, and what loading must still prove}
\label{sec:loading-boundary}
% =============================================================================

The universal construction of Part~I reconstructs the complete positive word
hierarchy of the relationally completed origin object of
\Cref{sec:relational-completion}.  It therefore already contains the neutral
protocol histories together with the persistent relation core: chronological
shifts, outcome and branch projections, the old $A_3$ root, the fast root path
and its waiting statistics, recurrent source and target states, record writers,
boundary and interface labels, routing choices, and their mixed words with the
predictive core.  These histories do not have to be re-admitted separately by
every domain, and the old structural tensor is recovered by forgetting them.

The universal construction still does not assign a domain semantic merely by
naming a coordinate.  A history becomes a physical metric, Lorentz holonomy,
colour current, fermion type, Yukawa map, chain differential, or generation
direction only when its actual response rows satisfy the corresponding finite
relations and provenance tests.  In particular, the metric, coframe,
connection, curvature, and ADM variables are deterministic compilers from the
root-path, speed, and field records; they are not newly inserted primitive
letters.

This part therefore introduces loaded subhierarchies of one universal
relational object, not unrelated sector tensors.  The SM--spacetime tensor
selects the relevant persistent relation and geometric histories, adds the
future-minimal internal configuration and physical coefficient/action packets,
and evaluates the same-history Schur, Ward, BRST, stress, and Perron--Doob
residuals proving that the gravitational and internal variations inhabit one
source-minimal carrier.

\begin{definition}[Admissible finite domain loading]
\label{def:admissible-loading}
Fix a cutoff $X$ and the saturated operational history algebra
$\mathcal A_X^{\rm hist}$ reconstructed in Part~I, with faithful physical inner
product $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_X$.  An \emph{admissible finite domain
loading} consists of:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(L\arabic*)},leftmargin=3em]
\item a finite typed family
      $\Sigma^{\rm sel}_{L,X}\subseteq\mathcal A_X^{\rm hist}$ of selected
      universal core or record histories;
\item a finite typed $*$-alphabet $\Sigma^{\rm phys}_{L,X}$ of genuinely
      domain-specific physical generators and a boundary- and type-preserving
      assignment
      \[
       \jmath^{\rm phys}_{L,X}:\Sigma^{\rm phys}_{L,X}
       \longrightarrow\mathcal A_X^{\rm hist},
      \]
      or, when a generator is independently sourced, an explicitly certified
      inserted panel or joint router on the same covered carrier;
\item preservation of formal adjoints and representation of every declared
      composable word by the corresponding product in
      $\mathcal A_X^{\rm hist}$;
\item finite inserted panels for every additional transfer, symmetry, grading,
      real structure, differential, incidence, or interface operator used in a
      statement;
\item reduction of the combined selected and physical source by the actual
      future-null relation rather than by a target-facing quotient.
\end{enumerate}
Write
\[
 \widehat\Sigma_{L,X}
 :=\Sigma^{\rm sel}_{L,X}
   \cup\jmath^{\rm phys}_{L,X}(\Sigma^{\rm phys}_{L,X}).
\]
The loading is \emph{source complete} when the unit and the words in
$\widehat\Sigma_{L,X}$ span one reducing source-cyclic subalgebra of
$\mathcal A_X^{\rm hist}$ after conditional minimalization in every retained
record sector.
\end{definition}

For $r\ge0$, let $\mathcal W_{L,X,\le r}$ be the vector space with basis the
composable words of length at most $r$ in $\widehat\Sigma_{L,X}$, and define
\[
 W_{L,X,r}e_{a_k\cdots a_1}:=a_k\cdots a_1,
 \qquad W_{L,X,r}e_\varnothing=\one.
\]

\begin{definition}[Loaded Grand-Tensor hierarchy]
\label{def:loaded-hierarchy}
The loaded word-Gram hierarchy associated with the domain loading is
\[
 \boxed{
 \boldsymbol{\mathbb T}^{L}_{\Grand,X}
 :=\{\mathbb K^L_{X,r}\}_{r\ge0},
 \qquad
 \mathbb K^L_{X,r}:=W_{L,X,r}^*W_{L,X,r}.}
\]
It is retained together with the loaded type and record decomposition, word
concatenation, involution, and all inserted panels named in
\Cref{def:admissible-loading}.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Canonical emergence of every admissibly loaded subhierarchy]
\label{thm:loaded-subhierarchy}
Let the full operational Grand Tensor of Part~I exist at cutoff $X$, and let an
admissible finite domain loading be given.  Then:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\roman*)},leftmargin=2.8em]
\item every $\mathbb K^L_{X,r}$ is positive and all of its entries are finite
      linear combinations of universal word-Gram entries and declared inserted
      panels;
\item selected chronology, outcome, routing, boundary, incidence-provenance,
      and interface records require no additional source-admission theorem;
\item the loaded future-null combinations form a two-sided $*$-ideal and the
      quotient is canonically the source-generated algebra
      $C^*(\widehat\Sigma_{L,X})$;
\item the loaded hierarchy reaches a finite flat depth and reconstructs this
      algebra up to the unique loading-fixing, record-preserving unitary;
\item if the universal cutoff embeddings carry the selected histories and the
      physical letters and panels compatibly, the loaded hierarchies are cutoff
      compatible;
\item no additional pair-specific cross-kernel or word-by-word writer axiom is
      required for histories already lying in the universal operational
      history algebra.
\end{enumerate}
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Positivity is immediate from
$\mathbb K^L_{X,r}=W_{L,X,r}^*W_{L,X,r}$.  Every selected history is already a
class in $\mathcal A_X^{\rm hist}$ by
\Cref{thm:record-survival,thm:grand-emergence}; every admitted physical letter
is either another class in that algebra or is supplied by an inserted panel or
joint router on the same saturated carrier.  Hence every loaded inner product
is a finite matrix coefficient reconstructed by the universal word Grams and
\Cref{thm:inserted-panel-certificate}.  This proves the first two items.

If a loaded polynomial $q$ is future null, then every left or right
multiplication by a loaded word is an admitted mixed history context and
remains null; taking adjoints preserves nullity.  Thus the null space is a
two-sided $*$-ideal.  Its represented quotient is exactly the algebra
generated by $\widehat\Sigma_{L,X}$.

That algebra is a subalgebra of the finite-dimensional
$\mathcal A_X^{\rm hist}$, hence finite dimensional.  The nested loaded word
spans therefore stabilize.  At the first rank equality, the proof of
\Cref{thm:automatic-history-saturation} shows that the stabilized span is
invariant under every loaded generator and contains the unit, so it is the
whole loaded algebra.  The Gram reconstruction proof of
\Cref{thm:flat-monoidal-reconstruction} gives the unique loading-fixing
unitary; the retained record projections force it to preserve the record
sectors.  Cutoff compatibility is the same intertwining calculation as in
\Cref{thm:cutoff-compatibility}, restricted to the loaded word spaces.  The
final statement follows from the canonical compiler, deterministic universal
writers, and two-phase reconstruction.
\end{proof}

\begin{principle}[Universal records are selected, not reloaded]
\label{prin:universal-record-selection}
The following labels may be selected from the universal record algebra whenever
they were independently generated by the declared protocol:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(U\arabic*)},leftmargin=3em]
\item causal order, clock ticks, face and boundary identity, orientation,
      endpoint transport, and traversal order for spacetime and holonomy;
\item pre-central type, revision, incidence, source/target, and Walsh-order
      labels for matter;
\item oriented edge, vertex, loop word, base point, and gluing-choice labels for
      gauge and interface sectors;
\item time slice, cell, flux direction, refinement ancestry, and regulator level
      for PDE loadings;
\item chain degree, cell or local-condition label, differential provenance,
      determinant-line orientation, and filtration level for chain, Hodge, and
      BSD-type loadings;
\item word length, gate, parallel layer, communication, memory access,
      precision, and branching labels for resource-faithful complexity.
\end{enumerate}
Selection preserves operational provenance only.  The corresponding metric,
holonomy, matter occurrence, differential, conservation law, determinant-line
comparison, or resource estimate remains a domain theorem.
\end{principle}

\begin{definition}[Loaded relation residual]
\label{def:loaded-relation-residual}
For a noncommutative $*$-polynomial $p$ in the combined selected and physical
generators, define
\[
 \boxed{
 \mathfrak R_{p,X}
 :=\langle p(\widehat\Sigma_{L,X}),
            p(\widehat\Sigma_{L,X})\rangle_X\ge0.}
\]
For a finite relation list $\mathscr P$, put
$\mathfrak R_{\mathscr P,X}=\sum_{p\in\mathscr P}\mathfrak R_{p,X}$.
\end{definition}

\begin{proposition}[Zero-residual criterion for physical loading]
\label{prop:zero-loading-relations}
Because the physical inner product on the future quotient is faithful,
\[
 \boxed{
 \mathfrak R_{\mathscr P,X}=0
 \iff
 p(\widehat\Sigma_{L,X})=0\quad\text{for every }p\in\mathscr P.}
\]
Thus finite Clifford, determinant, grading, incidence, commutant, Ward, chain,
and other algebraic relations can be tested without identifying a target basis
in advance.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proof}
Every term in the sum is a squared norm and is therefore nonnegative.  The sum
vanishes exactly when every term vanishes.  Faithfulness of the physical inner
product makes a vector have zero norm exactly when it is the zero class in the
future quotient.
\end{proof}

\begin{firewall}[Operational completeness is not a domain loading]
\label{fire:universality-not-loading}
The full operational Grand Tensor supplies the carrier, neutral protocol
records, all canonical word comparisons, conditional source-minimality, and a
finite reconstruction calculus.  It does not prove that a proposed metric,
curvature, Standard-Model current, grading-changing occurrence, gauge
holonomy, chain map, or unrelated laboratory arithmetic response is physically
present.  Such a generator is loaded only after its source is future visible,
its mixed histories lie on one covered carrier, and its defining residuals
vanish.  Arithmetic does not violate this boundary: its basic finite packet is
derived from the universal chronology record by Peano and finite Euler
relations, whereas an unrelated physical prime port remains an optional source
comparison.  Orthogonal independently sourced ideals must still be routed or
retained separately.
\end{firewall}

% =============================================================================
\subsection{Source-native reduction of the finite SM--spacetime entrance}
\label{sec:SMST-source-native-reduction}
% =============================================================================

The no-go theorem \Cref{cth:SM-bare-universal-no-go} remains in force: a bare
grading-even operational tensor does not manufacture a matter-odd coefficient.
The purpose of the source-native branch is different.  It identifies the
objects already contained in the calibrated Store and locked protected records
before any Standard-Model terminology is imposed, and then proves that the
corresponding loading hypotheses are redundant.

\begin{theorem}[Protected-sign odd shorting and matter-route theorem]
\label{thm:SMST-store-native-route}
Let $G=G^*$ be reconstructed from a coherently calibrated link
$U_t=e^{-itG}$ with $t\|G\|_{\op}<\pi$, and let $Z=Z^*=Z^{-1}$ be an actual
protected binary record involution.  Put
\[
 P_R=\frac{I+Z}{2},\qquad P_L=\frac{I-Z}{2},\qquad
 B=P_LGP_R,
\]
and
\[
 G_{\rm ev}=\frac12(G+ZGZ),\qquad
 G_{\rm odd}=\frac12(G-ZGZ).
\]
Then:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(R\arabic*)},leftmargin=3em]
\item the generator is reconstructed exactly by
      \[
       \boxed{G=\frac{i}{t}\operatorname{Log}U_t;}
      \]
\item the even and odd shortings are orthogonal and
      \[
       \boxed{G_{\rm odd}=B+B^*,\qquad
       \|G_{\rm odd}\|_{\HS}^2=2\|B\|_{\HS}^2;}
      \]
\item the exact matter margin is
      \[
       \boxed{
       \eta_Z(G):=\|B\|_{\HS}^2
       =\frac18\|[Z,G]\|_{\HS}^2,}
      \]
      while
      \[
       \boxed{\|\{Z,G\}\|_{\HS}^2=4\|G_{\rm ev}\|_{\HS}^2;}
      \]
      hence simultaneous grading-even Store dynamics does not obstruct a
      nonzero matter route;
\item if $B\ne0$, the canonical normalized route is the polar partial isometry
      \[
       \boxed{F_Z=B(B^*B)^{\dagger/2},}
      \]
      and the generator-level occurrence form is the nonzero CP map
      $\rho\mapsto B\rho B^*$;
\item for arbitrary even dynamics,
      \[
       A_s:=P_Le^{-isG}P_R=-isB+\mathcal R_s,
      \]
      with
      \[
       \boxed{
       \|\mathcal R_s\|_{\op}
       \le e^{|s|\|G\|}-1-|s|\|G\|.}
      \]
      Consequently
      $s^{-2}A_s(\,\cdot\,)A_s^*\to B(\,\cdot\,)B^*$ in diamond norm as
      $s\to0$.
\end{enumerate}
If no binary record is declared and one insists that the complete generator be
odd, the earlier coefficient-graph test applies: a record-diagonal anticommuting
involution exists exactly when the protected coefficient graph is loop free
and bipartite.  That reconstruction is a fallback; it is not required when the
sign is already an operational record.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
The spectral hypothesis places $U_t$ in the principal-logarithm domain.  In the
$Z$-eigenspace decomposition,
\[
 G=\begin{pmatrix}G_R&B^*\\ B&G_L\end{pmatrix},
 \qquad
 G_{\rm ev}=\begin{pmatrix}G_R&0\\0&G_L\end{pmatrix},
 \qquad
 G_{\rm odd}=\begin{pmatrix}0&B^*\\B&0\end{pmatrix}.
\]
Orthogonality of the four matrix corners gives the norm identities.  Direct
multiplication gives
$[Z,G]=2(B^*-B)$ in block notation and
$\{Z,G\}=2ZG_{\rm ev}$, proving the displayed formulas.  The Moore--Penrose
polar decomposition gives $F_Z$ and the CP occurrence statement.

The exponential series gives
$e^{-isG}=I-isG+\sum_{n\ge2}(-isG)^n/n!$.  Compressing by $P_L,P_R$ leaves the
linear term $-isB$, while the tail has the stated norm bound.  The standard
estimate
$\|K(\cdot)K^*-L(\cdot)L^*\|_\diamond
 \le(\|K\|+\|L\|)\|K-L\|$
then gives convergence of the rescaled CP forms.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Locked sign reuse exports the selected Store phase as matter]
\label{thm:SMST-phase-grading-route}
Let $Z_{\rm ph}$ be the signed-return involution of the selected Store phase and
$Z_{\rm gr}$ the proposed pre-central left/right grading, both contained in the
protected classical record algebra.  For $\epsilon\in\{\pm1\}$ define
\[
 \Delta_{\rm id}^{\epsilon}
 :=\widehat\tau_{\rm rec}
   \bigl((Z_{\rm gr}-\epsilon Z_{\rm ph})^2\bigr).
\]
Then
\[
 \boxed{\Delta_{\rm id}^{\epsilon}=0
 \iff Z_{\rm gr}=\epsilon Z_{\rm ph}.}
\]
If $C_{\rm odd}$ is the nonzero signed-return coefficient selected by
\[
 \gamma_{\rm odd,X}>0,\qquad \Delta_{\rm phase,X}=0
\]
in \Cref{thm:primitive-phase-selection}, and
$\Delta_{\rm id}^{\epsilon}=0$, then
\[
 \boxed{\{Z_{\rm gr},C_{\rm odd}\}=0}
\]
and at least one cross-support corner
$P_LC_{\rm odd}P_R$ or $P_RC_{\rm odd}P_L$ is nonzero.  On every
multiplicity-one typed branch its polar part is the unique normalized
source-native matter route.  Distinct protected accepted branches contribute
positively to the occurrence Kossakowski operator and cannot cancel by relative
phase.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
The commuting binary record involutions are diagonal on the minimal record
points.  Their squared difference equals four on points where the two signs
disagree and zero elsewhere; faithfulness of the record trace proves the first
criterion.  If $Z_{\rm gr}=\epsilon Z_{\rm ph}$ and
$\{Z_{\rm ph},C_{\rm odd}\}=0$, the grading anticommutator vanishes.  A nonzero
odd operator has a nonzero off-diagonal corner.  On a multiplicity-one typed
line, Schur's lemma gives $B^*B=\kappa P_{\rm src}$, so
$\kappa^{-1/2}B$ is the unique normalized route up to the invisible Kraus
phase.  Finally
$\sum_j|B_j)(B_j|\succeq0$ vanishes exactly when every protected branch
coefficient $B_j$ vanishes.
\end{proof}


\begin{definition}[Record and action grading residuals]
\label{def:SMST-grading-residuals}
Let $Z_0,Z_1$ be protected self-adjoint unitaries and let
$\bm c=(c_1,\ldots,c_s)$ be a finite $*$-closed generating tuple for a loaded
action algebra $\mathcal A=C^*(\bm c)$.  Put
\[
 U_{10}=Z_1Z_0,
\]
\[
 \boxed{
 \Delta_{\rm gr}^{\rm act}(Z_1,Z_0\mid\bm c)
 :=\sum_{j=1}^s\|Z_1c_jZ_1-Z_0c_jZ_0\|_{\HS}^2,}
\]
\[
 \boxed{
 \Delta_{\rm gr}^{\rm split}(Z_1,Z_0\mid\bm c)
 :=\sum_{j=1}^s
 \|(c_j)_{Z_1}^{\rm odd}-(c_j)_{Z_0}^{\rm odd}\|_{\HS}^2.}
\]
If $Z_0$ belongs to a finite faithful classical record algebra, let
$E_{Z_0}$ be the trace-preserving conditional expectation onto $C^*(Z_0)$ and
define
\[
 \boxed{
 \Delta_{\rm fib}(Z_1\mid Z_0)
 :=\|Z_1-E_{Z_0}Z_1\|_{2}^{2}.}
\]
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Grading automorphism and residual commutant]
\label{thm:SMST-grading-commutant}
For the data of \Cref{def:SMST-grading-residuals},
\[
 \boxed{
 \Delta_{\rm gr}^{\rm act}(Z_1,Z_0\mid\bm c)
 =\sum_j\|[c_j,U_{10}]\|_{\HS}^2
 =4\Delta_{\rm gr}^{\rm split}(Z_1,Z_0\mid\bm c).}
\]
Consequently the following are equivalent:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\roman*)},leftmargin=2.8em]
\item $\Delta_{\rm gr}^{\rm act}=0$;
\item $U_{10}\in\mathcal A'$;
\item $Z_1XZ_1=Z_0XZ_0$ for every $X\in\mathcal A$;
\item the even and odd shortings defined by $Z_0$ and $Z_1$ agree on every
      loaded action word.
\end{enumerate}
Under the finite Howe duality
$\mathcal A'=\mathcal M_{\rm type}$, the complete ambiguity between two
implementers of the same physical grading therefore lies in the residual
generation/flavour multiplicity algebra.  If both $Z_0$ and $Z_1$ commute with
$\mathcal M_{\rm type}$, then
\[
 \boxed{U_{10}\in Z(\mathcal M_{\rm type}),
 \qquad U_{10}=U_{10}^*=U_{10}^{-1}.}
\]
Thus, on the minimal central projections $z_a$ of the multiplicity algebra,
\[
 \boxed{U_{10}=\sum_a\epsilon_a z_a,
 \qquad \epsilon_a\in\{\pm1\}.}
\]
If the multiplicity algebra is a factor, $Z_1=\pm Z_0$.  One nonzero oriented
Read in each central block fixes the literal writer signs; the graded matter,
CAR, incidence, and finite-Dirac algebra require only the common grading
automorphism.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Unitary multiplication gives
\[
 Z_1(Z_1c_jZ_1-Z_0c_jZ_0)Z_0=[c_j,U_{10}],
\]
which proves the first equality of norms.  The difference of the two odd
shortings is one half of the negative conjugation difference, proving the
factor four.  The residual vanishes exactly when $U_{10}$ commutes with the
generating tuple.  Since $Z_1=U_{10}Z_0$, this is equivalent to equality of the
two conjugation automorphisms on $\mathcal A$, and hence to equality of their
even and odd projections.

If both signs commute with the multiplicity algebra, their product belongs to
its centre.  It commutes with $Z_0$, so it is a self-adjoint unitary.  Every
self-adjoint unitary in a finite-dimensional centre is $\pm1$ on each minimal
central summand.  A nonzero source in one summand detects its sign.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Binary record rigidity for the pre-central grading]
\label{thm:SMST-record-grading-rigidity}
Let $Z_{\rm ph}$ and $Z_{\rm gr}$ be protected binary writers in one faithful
finite record algebra, with both sign fibres of $Z_{\rm ph}$ nonzero.  Then
\[
 \boxed{
 \Delta_{\rm fib}(Z_{\rm gr}\mid Z_{\rm ph})=0}
\]
if and only if $Z_{\rm gr}$ is constant on every locked-sign fibre.  On this
branch
\[
 Z_{\rm gr}\in\{I,-I,Z_{\rm ph},-Z_{\rm ph}\}.
\]
If the pre-central grading remains a nonconstant two-point writer after
minimal-record reduction, then
\[
 \boxed{Z_{\rm gr}=\pm Z_{\rm ph}.}
\]
In particular, if the locked pointer is a deterministic bijective writer of
$Z_{\rm ph}$ and the proposed grading is a nonconstant deterministic writer of
the same pointer record, the grading-automorphism and full-cell odd-splitting
residuals vanish identically.  A single oriented accepted branch fixes the
literal sign.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Conditional expectation is the orthogonal projection in the record
$L^2$-space.  If the conditional mean of $Z_{\rm gr}$ on a locked-sign fibre
is $m_\sigma$, then, because $Z_{\rm gr}^2=I$,
\[
 \Delta_{\rm fib}
 =\sum_{\sigma=\pm}p_\sigma(1-m_\sigma^2).
\]
Faithfulness makes this zero exactly when the binary writer is constant on
each fibre.  There are four binary functions on a two-point set, giving the
four displayed possibilities.  Nonconstancy removes the two scalar choices.
The pointer statement follows by composition of deterministic writer maps and
\Cref{thm:SMST-grading-commutant}.
\end{proof}

\begin{firewall}[Grading automorphism versus an oriented label]
The source-native matter short, graded CAR, incidence, and finite-Dirac
relations depend on the grading automorphism of the loaded action algebra.
They do not require a preferred global sign for its implementing involution.
A literal assertion that two protected record writers are identically labelled
is stronger and requires the corresponding orientation Reads.  Conversely,
zero record-fibre variance is a certificate, not an assumption: a positive
variance exposes additional information within a locked-sign fibre and that
direction must remain in the Grand Tensor.
\end{firewall}

\begin{firewall}[Matter existence versus a purely odd Store]
The condition $\{Z,G\}=0$ means that the complete Store generator is purely
odd.  It is not the matter-existence condition.  Matter requires only
$P_LGP_R\ne0$.  Thus an even gauge, scalar, diagonal Store, or normal component
must not be counted as a failure of the finite matter loader.
\end{firewall}


\begin{corollary}[Source-native incidence factor from the locked odd route]
\label{cor:locked-odd-incidence-factor}
Fix an oriented edge branch of the selected locked phase.  Suppose its
shortened cross-support coefficient
$B_e=P_{e,L}B_eP_{e,R}$ has equal-rank endpoint supports and satisfies
\[
 B_e^*B_e=\kappa_eP_{e,R},
 \qquad
 B_eB_e^*=\kappa_eP_{e,L},
 \qquad
 B_{\bar e}=z_eB_e^*,\quad |z_e|=1,
\]
with $\kappa_e>0$.  Then the polar route
$V_e=\kappa_e^{-1/2}B_e$ generates the Hermitian involutions
\[
 X_e=V_e+V_e^*,\qquad
 Y_e=i(V_e-V_e^*),\qquad
 Z_e=P_{e,R}-P_{e,L},
\]
which form one Pauli factor and obey
\[
 \boxed{-\frac i2[X_e,Y_e]=Z_e.}
\]
If the locked phase sign is the pre-central grading, then $Z_e$ is precisely
that protected sign up to the globally chosen orientation.  Thus the two
endpoint axes of a shared-edge incidence packet are derived from one nonzero
odd route and its reversal; they are not additional independent generators.

For several edges, simultaneous tensor-product incidence is certified by the
vanishing cross-edge commutator residual of
\Cref{thm:locked-incidence-profile}.  The endpoint, action, renewal-contrast,
incidence-current, and tangential triplets are one physical source precisely
when their $S_4$-scalar joint Gram has rank one; equality of marginal Grams is
insufficient.
\end{corollary}

\begin{proof}
The two effect identities make $V_e$ a unitary partial isometry between the
endpoint supports.  Direct multiplication in the decomposition
$P_{e,R}\oplus P_{e,L}$ gives the Pauli relations and the commutator formula.
The sign identification is \Cref{thm:SMST-phase-grading-route}.  The final
statements are the parallelization and common-source criteria of
\Cref{thm:locked-incidence-profile}.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Graded monoidal CAR packet and branch-complete one-doublet theorem]
\label{thm:SMST-monoidal-CAR}
On a resolved nonzero Store parity cell, let
$f=P_LF_ZP_R$ and $\pi=P_R-P_L$.  Two protected parallel Store slots carry
\[
 b_1^\dagger=f\otimes I,
 \qquad
 b_2^\dagger=\pi\otimes f,
 \qquad b_i=(b_i^\dagger)^*.
\]
Then
\[
 \boxed{
 \{b_i,b_j^\dagger\}=\delta_{ij}I,
 \qquad
 \{b_i,b_j\}=\{b_i^\dagger,b_j^\dagger\}=0.}
\]
Hence the Store histories generate the two-mode CAR algebra and its weak
one-particle space $W\cong\C^2$; exterior creation and contraction, combined
with the revision fibre, give the four canonical up, down, charged-lepton, and
neutral incidence rows.

Let $G_2$ be an arbitrary self-adjoint two-slot generator, let
$\Pi=\pi\otimes\pi$, and short first to
$G_2^{\rm odd}=(G_2-\Pi G_2\Pi)/2$.  With normalized Hilbert--Schmidt norms set
\[
 a_1=d^{-1}\Tr_2G_2^{\rm odd},
 \qquad
 a_2=d^{-1}\Tr_1[(\pi\otimes I)G_2^{\rm odd}],
\]
\[
 R_{\rm conn}=G_2^{\rm odd}-a_1\otimes I-\pi\otimes a_2,
 \quad
 \Delta_{\rm conn}=\|R_{\rm conn}\|_2^2,
 \quad
 \Delta_{\rm slot}^{\sigma}=\frac12\|a_1-\sigma a_2\|_2^2.
\]
For $g_\sigma=(a_1+\sigma a_2)/2$,
\[
 \boxed{
 \|G_2^{\rm odd}-(g_\sigma\otimes I+
       \sigma\pi\otimes g_\sigma)\|_2^2
 =\Delta_{\rm conn}+\Delta_{\rm slot}^{\sigma}.}
\]
The strict primitive branch therefore has one weak Schmidt line
$h_\sigma=(e_1+\sigma e_2)/\sqrt2$.  More generally, let $S_{\rm ph}$ synthesize
the resolved reality-completed selected-phase odd tangents and put
\[
 H_{\rm ph}=S_{\rm ph}^*S_{\rm ph},
 \qquad
 g_{\rm ph}=S_{\rm ph}^*G_2^{\rm odd},
\]
\[
 \boxed{
 \Delta_{\rm prov}^{\rm odd}
 :=\|G_2^{\rm odd}\|_{\HS}^2
   -\langle g_{\rm ph},H_{\rm ph}^\dagger g_{\rm ph}\rangle.}
\]
If $\Delta_{\rm prov}^{\rm odd}=0$ and every selected primitive tangent has the
same $h_\sigma$, then the complete microscopic one-leg coefficient map has
rank one.  Thus the complete finite source contains exactly one weak scalar
doublet.  A positive provenance or primitivity residual is retained as an
additional odd interaction or scalar direction.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
The polar relations give
$f^2=(f^*)^2=0$, $f^*f=P_R$, $ff^*=P_L$, and $\pi f=-f\pi$; direct
multiplication gives the CAR identities.  The occupation-basis unitary gives
$\Lambda^\bullet W$, and its creation/contraction blocks are the canonical
multiplicity-one incidence maps.

The two graded-local subspaces $\{a\otimes I\}$ and
$\{\pi\otimes a\}$ are orthogonal isometric copies.  The displayed partial
traces are their orthogonal coordinates, and projection of $(a_1,a_2)$ onto
$(g,\sigma g)$ gives the Pythagorean formula.  The source Schur formula
\Cref{thm:source-Schur} gives
$\Delta_{\rm prov}^{\rm odd}=\|(I-P_{\rm ph})G_2^{\rm odd}\|^2$.
Zero residual places the complete odd tangent in the selected span.  Linearity
then factors every weak coefficient through the common functional
$x\mapsto\langle h_\sigma,x\rangle$, so the weak Gram has rank one.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Locked $K_4$ edge packet gives one endpoint generation triplet]
\label{thm:SMST-record-native-generations}
Fix one determinant-sign and one current-type branch of the locked opportunity
packet.  The intrinsic local relation source has already been reconstructed in
\Cref{thm:dimension-locked-K4-source} as
\[
 C_1(K_4)=\mathcal E_{\rm cut}\oplus\mathcal E_{\rm cyc},
 \qquad
 \dim\mathcal E_{\rm cut}=\dim\mathcal E_{\rm cyc}=3,
\]
with faithful orthogonal endpoint and loop ranges.  Let
\[
 Q:C_1(K_4)\longrightarrow\mathcal H_{\rm edge}
\]
be the same locked source measured in any faithful physical future metric.
Oriented $S_4$ covariance gives positive scalars $\alpha,\beta$ with
\[
 \boxed{Q^*Q=\alpha P_{\rm cut}+\beta P_{\rm cyc}.}
\]
For the endpoint source $T=Q\partial^*:W_0\to\mathcal H_{\rm edge}$,
\[
 \boxed{T^*T=4\alpha I_{W_0}.}
\]
Consequently the endpoint-conditioned matter source is centered, homogeneous,
source minimal and exactly rank three.  Its orthogonal cycle triplet remains
loop provenance and is not a second generation copy.  The generation
interpretation is made only after alignment with the matter/CAR incidence
source; the dimension-selection theorem itself uses neither colour, weak nor
generation semantics.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
The intrinsic cut--cycle decomposition, positivity and orthogonality are
\Cref{thm:dimension-locked-K4-source}.  A faithful $S_4$-invariant future metric
acts by a positive scalar on each inequivalent irreducible triplet, giving the
block-scalar Gram with $\alpha,\beta>0$.  The general boundary identity
\textup{(DS.2)} at $N=4$ gives
$\partial\partial^*=4I_{W_0}$ on the cut module and zero on the cycle module,
so $T^*T=4\alpha I$.  Orthogonality prevents the loop source from being counted
again as endpoint multiplicity.  The final semantic allocation is the mixed
source test of the finite matter packet, not a consequence of equal dimension.
\end{proof}

\begin{remark}[Historical and active tetrahedral branches]
The local $K_4/A_3$ source and its faithful endpoint/loop decomposition are
literal Store outputs.  A recurrent spatial interpretation is stronger: it is
historical exactly when the direct tables
$J_c(S_n,\alpha_n,S_{n+1})$ and
$J_\ell(S_n,\alpha_n,S_{n+1})$ pass the compiler of
\Cref{thm:dimension-recurrent-root-table}.  Otherwise the minimum conservative
active port is \Cref{thm:dimension-active-exchange}.  Equality with an austere
chronological four-point source or with a matter-generation source still
requires the corresponding mixed Gram; no marginal $K_4$ is identified by
name alone.
\end{remark}

\begin{theorem}[Saturated full-cell generator and finite-Dirac provenance]
\label{thm:SMST-generator-projections}
Let $G_F=G_F^*$ be reconstructed from a calibrated full-cell link and let
$S_F$ synthesize the already derived chiral-incidence-generation source.
Define
\[
 \mathcal K_n=\Span\{G_F^j\Ran S_F:0\le j\le n\}.
\]
At the first finite stabilization depth $n_*$, $\mathcal K_{n_*}$ reduces
$G_F$.  Hence, on the source-minimal saturated carrier $P_{\rm sat}$,
\[
 \boxed{(I-P_{\rm sat})G_FP_{\rm sat}=0.}
\]
A positive innovation Gram before stabilization constructs, rather than
discards, every required additional carrier direction.

Let $\Gamma_F$ be the finite grading and put
\[
 G_F^{\rm ev}=\frac12(G_F+\Gamma_FG_F\Gamma_F),
 \qquad
 G_F^{\rm odd}=\frac12(G_F-\Gamma_FG_F\Gamma_F).
\]
Let $\mathfrak D_F$ be the finite real linear space fixed by the already derived
type, carrier, record, grading, reality, order-one, neutral, and Majorana
relations, and let $\Pi_F^{\rm D}$ be its orthogonal projector.  Define
\[
 \boxed{D_F^{\rm can}=\Pi_F^{\rm D}
        (P_{\rm sat}G_F^{\rm odd}P_{\rm sat}),}
\]
\[
 \eta_F^{\rm D}=\|D_F^{\rm can}\|_{\HS}^2,
 \qquad
 \Delta_{F,{\rm odd}}^{\rm extra}
 =\|(I-\Pi_F^{\rm D})P_{\rm sat}G_F^{\rm odd}P_{\rm sat}\|_{\HS}^2.
\]
Then
\[
 \boxed{
 \|P_{\rm sat}G_FP_{\rm sat}\|_{\HS}^2
 =\|G_F^{\rm ev}\|_{\HS}^2
  +\eta_F^{\rm D}
  +\Delta_{F,{\rm odd}}^{\rm extra}.}
\]
The even component is legitimate simultaneous dynamics and is not a
finite-Dirac defect.

Let $S_{\rm ph}$ synthesize the reality-completed selected-phase tangents in
$\mathfrak D_F$ and define
\[
 \boxed{
 \Delta_{\rm prov,F}^{\rm odd}
 =\|G_F^{\rm odd}\|_{\HS}^2
  -(S_{\rm ph}^*G_F^{\rm odd})^*
   (S_{\rm ph}^*S_{\rm ph})^\dagger
   (S_{\rm ph}^*G_F^{\rm odd}).}
\]
If $\Delta_{\rm prov,F}^{\rm odd}=0$, then
\[
 \boxed{G_F^{\rm odd}=D_F^{\rm can},
 \qquad\Delta_{F,{\rm odd}}^{\rm extra}=0.}
\]
The five residue slots $Y_u,Y_d,Y_e,Y_\nu,M_R$ are then the typed carrier
contractions of one microscopic operator in one $H_1(K_4)$ frame.  Their
nonzero values, ranks, spectra, mixing, and CP invariants remain physical
outputs.

Finally, for the local kinematic algebra $\mathcal K_x$, Haar expectation onto
its commutant gives the canonical normal candidate
\[
 \boxed{
 n_x=\mathbb E_{\mathcal K_x'}(G_{F,x}^{\rm ev})
 -\frac{\Tr G_{F,x}^{\rm ev}}{\dim H_x}I.}
\]
If the commutant is scalar, $n_x=0$.  The finite-Dirac and normal components are
thus derived from one generator and require no separate finite router.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
The nested Krylov spaces stabilize in finite dimension.  Invariance under
$G_F$ at the first equality, together with self-adjointness, makes the stabilized
space reducing.  The innovation Gram is the squared norm of the next orthogonal
Krylov layer, as in \Cref{thm:universal-moment-leakage}.

Even and odd shortings are orthogonal.  Orthogonal projection of the odd part
onto $\mathfrak D_F$ gives the displayed Pythagorean decomposition.  The source
Schur formula identifies $\Delta_{\rm prov,F}^{\rm odd}$ with the squared
orthogonal distance of $G_F^{\rm odd}$ from the selected tangent span.  Every
selected tangent lies in $\mathfrak D_F$ by the locked type, carrier, writer,
reversal, and charge-real relations, so zero provenance residual places the
complete odd generator in $\mathfrak D_F$ and makes its projection equal to
itself.  Multiplicity-one carrier contraction gives the five residue blocks.
Haar averaging over the compact unitary group of $\mathcal K_x$ is the
Hilbert--Schmidt conditional expectation onto $\mathcal K_x'$; subtracting the
scalar part proves the last statement.
\end{proof}


\begin{theorem}[Unique calibrated reversal writer]
\label{thm:SMST-reversal-writer}
Let $E$ be a finite coefficient space, let
$\mathsf S(x_+,x_-)=(x_-,x_+)$ on $E\oplus E$, and let
$\pi_\pm:E\oplus E\to E$ be the coordinate projections.  For a physical
half-step $t>0$, the map
\[
 \boxed{
 J_t:E\longrightarrow E\oplus E,
 \qquad J_tx=\frac1{2t}(x,-x)}
\]
is the unique linear writer satisfying
\[
 \boxed{
 \mathsf SJ=-J,
 \qquad t(\pi_+-\pi_-)J=I_E.}
\]
Let $B_+,B_-:E\to\mathcal Y$ be jointly visible protected forward and reverse
sources, let
$\mathcal B(x_+,x_-)=B_+x_++B_-x_-$, and put
\[
 B_{\rm rev}=\mathcal BJ_t=\frac{B_+-B_-}{2t}.
\]
If a claimed Hodge/current source is generated by one deterministic writer
$B_H=\mathcal BJ$ and the two displayed writer identities hold, then
\[
 \boxed{B_H=B_{\rm rev}.}
\]
More generally, with
\[
 \varepsilon_{\rm rev}=\|\mathsf SJ+J\|,
 \qquad
 \varepsilon_{\rm cal}=\|t(\pi_+-\pi_-)J-I\|,
\]
one has
\[
 \boxed{
 \|B_H-B_{\rm rev}\|
 \le\|\mathcal B\|
 \left(\frac{\varepsilon_{\rm rev}}2
       +\frac{\varepsilon_{\rm cal}}{\sqrt2\,t}\right).}
\]
Every quantity is reconstructed from the joint forward/reverse source Gram and
the deterministic writer table.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Write $Jx=(J_+x,J_-x)$.  Reversal oddness gives $J_-=-J_+$, while calibration
gives $2tJ_+=I$, proving uniqueness.  For the estimate, put
$K=(J_++J_-)/2$ and $L=(J_+-J_-)/2$.  The two residuals bound
$\|K\|\le\varepsilon_{\rm rev}/(2\sqrt2)$ and
$\|L-(2t)^{-1}I\|\le\varepsilon_{\rm cal}/(2t)$.  Recombining the two
coordinates yields the stated operator bound and multiplication by
$\mathcal B$ gives the source estimate.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Orthogonal same-history provenance decomposition]
\label{thm:SMST-provenance-Pythagoras}
Assume a retained reversal involution $\Theta$ satisfies
$\Theta B_+=B_-$ and $\Theta B_-=B_+$.  Let $P_{\rm pair}$ project onto
$\Ran B_++\Ran B_-$ and put
\[
 P_{\rm ev}=\frac12(I+\Theta),
 \qquad P_{\rm odd}=\frac12(I-\Theta).
\]
For an arbitrary claimed source $B_H:E\to\mathcal Y$, define
\[
 L_H=(I-P_{\rm pair})B_H,
\]
\[
 E_H=P_{\rm ev}P_{\rm pair}B_H,
\]
\[
 N_H=P_{\rm odd}P_{\rm pair}B_H-B_{\rm rev}.
\]
Then the three ranges are mutually orthogonal and
\[
 \boxed{
 (B_H-B_{\rm rev})^*(B_H-B_{\rm rev})
 =L_H^*L_H+E_H^*E_H+N_H^*N_H.}
\]
Thus same-history failure splits canonically into pair-span leakage,
reversal-even leakage, and normalization/orientation failure.  The complete
provenance residual vanishes exactly when all three positive panels vanish.
Moreover
\[
 \boxed{
 P_{\rm pair}=\mathcal B(\mathcal B^*\mathcal B)^\dagger\mathcal B^*,}
\]
so every panel is reconstructed from the joint source Gram and the retained
reversal action.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
The pair range reduces $\Theta$.  Insert
\[
 I=(I-P_{\rm pair})+P_{\rm ev}P_{\rm pair}
   +P_{\rm odd}P_{\rm pair}
\]
into $B_H$ and subtract $B_{\rm rev}$.  The three terms lie respectively
outside the pair range, in its even part, and in its odd part, proving
orthogonality and the Gram identity.  The Moore--Penrose formula is the
orthogonal projection onto $\Ran\mathcal B$.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Record-native finite provenance closure]
\label{cor:SMST-record-native-provenance}
If the Hodge/current writer is deterministically generated from the protected
forward/reverse pair, is reversal odd, and is calibrated by the physical
half-step, then
\[
 \boxed{
 B_H=B_{\rm rev},
 \qquad
 \mathbb P_{H\mid\pm}:=(B_H-B_{\rm rev})^*(B_H-B_{\rm rev})=0.}
\]
If only the three positive panels of
\Cref{thm:SMST-provenance-Pythagoras} are available, their vanishing is an
equivalent finite certificate.  Reversal parity alone is insufficient: an
orthogonal copy of the same odd type may still have nonzero pair-span leakage.
\end{corollary}

\begin{proof}
Apply \Cref{thm:SMST-reversal-writer} and then
\Cref{thm:SMST-provenance-Pythagoras}.
\end{proof}



% -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
\subsubsection{Literal locked-cylinder provenance and private multiplicity}
\label{sec:SMST-literal-provenance}
% -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

The protected entry, dwell, terminal-edge, sign, and current coordinates are
historical Reads of one resolved accepted cylinder.  Their mixed source Grams
are therefore ordinary finite cylinder moments; an earlier entry label need
not be copied to the terminal cut merely to reconstruct its correlation with a
later locked edge.  A persistent copy remains necessary only when a later
physical operation is controlled by the earlier value.

Let
\[
 \mathscr S_{\rm term}
 =\{(+,c),(+,\ell),(-,c),(-,\ell)\}
\]
be the four terminal sign/current cells.  In a fixed cell \(c\), let
\[
 q_{0,c},\ q_{t,c},\ q_{h,c},\ q_{o,c}\ge0
\]
be the accepted-conditioned masses of the four diagonal-\(S_4\) incidence
orbits of the entry half-edge and terminal edge, and let
\[
 0\le t_{r,c}\le q_{r,c}
\]
be the same masses with the additional private-tail predicate \(N\ge1\).
Put
\[
 \tau_c=\sum_rq_{r,c},
 \qquad
 \sigma_c=\sum_rt_{r,c},
\]
\[
 E_c=q_{0,c}+q_{t,c}-q_{h,c}-q_{o,c},
\]
\[
 A_c=2q_{0,c}-q_{t,c}+q_{h,c}-2q_{o,c},
\]
and define \(E_c^{(1)},A_c^{(1)}\) by the same formulas with \(q\) replaced by
\(t\).

\begin{theorem}[Exact locked incidence-orbit polytope]
\label{thm:SMST-locked-orbit-polytope}
For one terminal cell, nonnegative orbit masses of total \(T\) and standard
coordinates \((E,A)\) exist if and only if
\[
 \boxed{|E+A|+|2E-A|\le3T.}
\]
Equivalently,
\[
 \boxed{|E|\le T,\qquad
 \left|A-\frac E2\right|\le\frac{3T}{2}.}
\]
The unretained matching coordinate \(D\) may then be chosen precisely in
\[
 \boxed{-T+|E+A|\le D\le2T-|2E-A|.}
\]
The four vertices of the projected polytope are
\[
 \boxed{
 (T,2T),\quad(T,-T),\quad(-T,T),\quad(-T,-2T).}
\]
Moreover the aggregate and binary-tail tables in cell \(c\) are jointly
positive exactly when
\[
 \boxed{
 |E_c^{(1)}+A_c^{(1)}|
 +|2E_c^{(1)}-A_c^{(1)}|
 \le3\sigma_c}
\]
and
\[
 \boxed{
 |(E_c-E_c^{(1)})+(A_c-A_c^{(1)})|
 +|2(E_c-E_c^{(1)})-(A_c-A_c^{(1)})|
 \le3(\tau_c-\sigma_c).}
\]
Thus six real statistics per terminal cell replace the eight raw aggregate
and tail orbit masses for every standard-sector positivity test.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
For one cell the inverse orbit transform is
\[
 q_0=\frac16(T+E+A+D),\qquad
 q_t=\frac16(2T+2E-A-D),
\]
\[
 q_h=\frac16(2T-2E+A-D),\qquad
 q_o=\frac16(T-E-A+D).
\]
Nonnegativity is equivalent to
\[
 D\ge-T-E-A,\qquad D\ge-T+E+A,
\]
and
\[
 D\le2T+2E-A,\qquad D\le2T-2E+A.
\]
Taking the larger lower bound and the smaller upper bound gives the displayed
interval.  It is nonempty exactly when
\(|E+A|+|2E-A|\le3T\).  The image of the nonnegative simplex is the convex
hull of the four displayed vertex images, which is the stated
parallelogram.

For the aggregate--tail assertion, apply the one-table criterion separately
to the nonnegative tail table \((t_{r,c})_r\) and to the nonnegative complement
\((q_{r,c}-t_{r,c})_r\).  Conversely, positive tail and complement tables add
to the required aggregate table.
\end{proof}

For each nonzero cell put
\[
 \alpha_c=
 \left(\frac{E_c}{\sqrt3},\frac{A_c}{\sqrt6}\right),
 \qquad
 \beta_c=
 \left(\frac{E_c^{(1)}}{\sqrt3},
       \frac{A_c^{(1)}}{\sqrt6}\right),
\]
let \(\mathbf A,\mathbf T\) be the matrices with rows
\(\alpha_c,\beta_c\), and put
\[
 W=\diag(\tau_c^\dagger:c\in\mathscr S_{\rm term}),
\]
where zero cells are assigned Moore--Penrose reciprocal zero.

\begin{theorem}[Explicit private-provenance compiler]
\label{thm:SMST-private-provenance-compiler}
On the accepted-conditioned diagonally \(S_4\)-covariant locked cylinder:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(P\arabic*)},leftmargin=3em]
\item the terminal standard multiplicity metric is
      \[
       \boxed{H_{\rm term}=\diag(\tau_c:c\in\mathscr S_{\rm term});}
      \]
      a zero-mass cell has \(\alpha_c=\beta_c=0\);
\item the aggregate, cross, and binary-tail source Grams are
      \[
       \boxed{
       G_A=\mathbf A^*W\mathbf A,\qquad
       C_{AT}=\mathbf A^*W\mathbf T,\qquad
       G_T=\mathbf T^*W\mathbf T;}
      \]
\item the readable provenance rank is decided by
      \[
       \boxed{
       \det G_A
       =\sum_{c<d}
        \frac{|\det(\alpha_c,\alpha_d)|^2}{\tau_c\tau_d};}
      \]
      hence only ranks \(0,1,2\) occur;
\item with
      \[
       Q=\supp G_A,\qquad
       P_{\rm priv}=G_A^\dagger C_{AT},
      \]
      the exact range and null residuals are
      \[
       \boxed{
       \mathsf S_{T\mid A}
       =G_T-C_{AT}^*G_A^\dagger C_{AT}
       =(\mathbf T-\mathbf AP_{\rm priv})^*
        W(\mathbf T-\mathbf AP_{\rm priv}),}
      \]
      \[
       \boxed{
       \mathsf N_{T\mid A}
       =(I-Q)G_T(I-Q)
       =\bigl(\mathbf T(I-Q)\bigr)^*
        W\bigl(\mathbf T(I-Q)\bigr);}
      \]
\item their joint zero branch gives the unique dressed propagator on the
      faithful readable quotient:
      \[
       \boxed{\mathbf T=\mathbf AP_{\rm priv},
       \qquad P_{\rm priv}=QP_{\rm priv}Q;}
      \]
\item if the private tail is homogeneous with survival probability \(s>0\),
      the undressed physical propagator is
      \[
       \boxed{M_{\rm priv}=P_{\rm priv}/s,}
      \]
      and physical contractivity is exactly
      \[
       \boxed{P_{\rm priv}^*G_AP_{\rm priv}\preceq s^2G_A.}
      \]
\end{enumerate}
On the rank-one branch the last condition is the scalar inequality
\(|p|\le s\).  On the rank-two branch it is equivalent to
\[
 \boxed{
 \Tr\mathsf D_s\ge0,\qquad
 \det\mathsf D_s\ge0,\qquad
 \mathsf D_s=s^2G_A-P_{\rm priv}^*G_AP_{\rm priv}.}
\]
All quantities are reconstructed from the twenty-four statistics
\[
 \boxed{
 (\tau_c,\sigma_c,E_c,A_c,E_c^{(1)},A_c^{(1)})
 _{c\in\mathscr S_{\rm term}}.}
\]
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Within a nonzero terminal cell, diagonal \(S_4\) covariance is transitive on
the six edges.  The normalized edge simplex frame has average outer product
\(I_{W_0}\), so that cell contributes \(\tau_cI_{W_0}\); different cells have
disjoint point support.  This proves the terminal metric and the three
weighted Gram formulas.

Writing \(\widetilde{\mathbf A}=W^{1/2}\mathbf A\), the \(2\times2\)
Cauchy--Binet identity gives the displayed determinant.  Since
\(C_{AT}=\mathbf A^*W\mathbf T\), its range is contained in
\(\Ran G_A\), so \(G_AG_A^\dagger C_{AT}=C_{AT}\).  Expanding the weighted
least-squares residual gives
\[
 (\mathbf T-\mathbf AP_{\rm priv})^*
 W(\mathbf T-\mathbf AP_{\rm priv})
 =G_T-C_{AT}^*G_A^\dagger C_{AT}.
\]
The null identity is immediate from \(G_T=\mathbf T^*W\mathbf T\).
Faithfulness of \(W\) on the nonzero cells makes zero weighted Gram equivalent
to rowwise vanishing.  The homogeneous-tail identity is
\(P_{\rm priv}=sM_{\rm priv}\).  On rank one the metric inequality is scalar;
on rank two a Hermitian \(2\times2\) matrix is positive semidefinite exactly
when its trace and determinant are nonnegative.
\end{proof}

\begin{countertheorem}[Locked marginals do not select a provenance branch]
\label{cth:SMST-provenance-marginals}
Fix positive terminal masses \(\tau_c\) and
\(\sigma_c=s\tau_c\), \(0<s<1\).  Diagonally \(S_4\)-invariant positive
cylinders with these same entry, terminal, acceptance, and binary-tail
marginals realize each of:
\[
 \boxed{
 \rank G_A=0,\quad
 \rank G_A=1,\quad
 \rank G_A=2,\quad
 \mathsf S_{T\mid A}>0,\quad
 P_{\rm priv}^*G_AP_{\rm priv}\npreceq s^2G_A.}
\]
Consequently no theorem based only on the marginals can force readable
provenance, homogeneous propagation, full rank, or contractivity.
\end{countertheorem}

\begin{proof}
The four incidence orbits have the same entry and terminal marginals.  Taking
the independent orbit proportions
\((1/6,1/3,1/3,1/6)\) makes every standard row zero.  Concentrating on one
orbit gives rank one.  Using two linearly independent pure-orbit rows in
different cells gives rank two.  Starting from a strictly positive
full-rank table with \(\mathbf T=s\mathbf A\), a sufficiently small
tail-only perturbation preserving each cell total breaks the common factor and
makes the Schur residual positive.  Finally, at \(s=1/3\), choose aggregate
rows \(\epsilon\tau_cu\) and tail rows \(s\tau_cu\) on one orbit direction,
with \(0<\epsilon<1\); the exact rank-one factor is \(p=s/\epsilon>s\).
All constructions preserve the prescribed marginals.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Private multiplicity export to the finite SM loading]
\label{cor:SMST-private-SM-export}
When the selected Store master cylinder contains the entry and matching-axis

exactly
\[
 \boxed{P_{\rm SM}=P_{\rm priv}=G_A^\dagger C_{AT},}

and on a homogeneous private tail

 \boxed{M_{\rm SM}=P_{\rm priv}/s.}

Thus no separate matching-axis, relative-orientation, or private-provenance

\begin{proof}
The entry and matching-axis frames are a canonical orthogonal basis of the
same two-copy standard source reconstructed above.  Their aggregate and
binary-tail coefficient rows are exactly \(\mathbf A\) and \(\mathbf T\).
The zero Schur branch therefore gives the displayed unique factor, and one

\end{proof}

Let
\[
 S_3:W_0\otimes E_3\longrightarrow\mathcal H,
 \qquad
 S_3^*S_3=I_{W_0}\otimes G,
\]
be the readable standard source, with \(\dim E_3\le2\), and let

standard source satisfying

 C_3^*C_3=a_3I_{W_0},
 \qquad
 C_3^*S_3=I_{W_0}\otimes\ell_3.

\begin{theorem}[No-double-counting allocation of the standard source]
\label{thm:SMST-standard-source-allocation}
Put
\[
 \boxed{R_3^{\rm chr}=G-a_3^{-1}\ell_3^*\ell_3\succeq0.}
\]
Then
\[
 \boxed{
 \Ran S_3(W_0\otimes\Ker R_3^{\rm chr})
 =\Ran S_3\cap\Ran C_3,}
\]
and, on the faithful coefficient quotient,

 \boxed{\dim\Ker R_3^{\rm chr}\le1.}
\]
Hence if \(\rank G=2\), at least one complete standard triplet remains
nonchronological and cannot be counted again as an independent spacetime
source.  That residual triplet is not automatically a Yukawa or finite-Dirac
seed; its protected typed support must be established independently.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
The projection onto the chronological source range is
\(P_{C_3}=C_3(a_3I)^{-1}C_3^*\), and
\[
 S_3^*(I-P_{C_3})S_3
 =I_{W_0}\otimes(G-a_3^{-1}\ell_3^*\ell_3).
\]
This proves the range identity.  Whitening on \(\supp G\) gives
\[
 G^{-1/2}R_3^{\rm chr}G^{-1/2}=I-u^*u
\]
for one row vector \(u=a_3^{-1/2}\ell_3G^{-1/2}\).  A rank-one operator can
annihilate at most one independent coefficient direction.
\end{proof}

\begin{definition}[Propagation-invariant Einstein eligibility]
\label{def:SMST-invariant-Einstein-eligibility}
Let \(E_3=\supp G_A\) be the faithful readable standard multiplicity space of
\Cref{thm:SMST-private-provenance-compiler}, let
\(P=P_{\rm priv}|_{E_3}\), and let
\[
 D_{\rm end}:E_3\longrightarrow\mathcal Y_{\rm end}
\]
be the measured difference between the actual chronological endpoint writer

 \boxed{
 \mathsf R_{\rm sel}
 :=D_{\rm end}^*D_{\rm end}
   +\mathsf S_{T\mid A}|_{E_3}
   +R_3^{\rm act}\succeq0.}
\]
For \(d=\dim E_3\), define the finite observability Gram
\[
 \boxed{
 \mathsf O_d(P,\mathsf R_{\rm sel})
 :=\sum_{n=0}^{d-1}(P^n)^*\mathsf R_{\rm sel}P^n.}
\]
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Canonical propagation-invariant Einstein subspace]
\label{thm:SMST-invariant-Einstein-subspace}
The subspace
\[
 \boxed{
 K_{\rm Ein}^{\rm std}:=\Ker\mathsf O_d(P,\mathsf R_{\rm sel})}
\]
is the largest \(P\)-invariant subspace contained in
\(\Ker\mathsf R_{\rm sel}\).  Equivalently,
\[
 \boxed{
 K_{\rm Ein}^{\rm std}
 =\{x:\mathsf R_{\rm sel}P^nx=0\text{ for every }n\ge0\}.}
\]
Every coefficient in this subspace, together with its complete propagated
orbit, has zero endpoint-writer mismatch, zero tail innovation, and zero
action-range innovation.

When \(d=2\), exactly one of the following occurs:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(E\arabic*)},leftmargin=3em]
\item \(\mathsf O_2\succ0\): no nonzero readable standard direction is
      Einstein eligible;
\item \(\rank\mathsf O_2=1\): \(K_{\rm Ein}^{\rm std}\) is one canonical
      line and every nonzero \(e\) in it obeys \(Pe=\lambda_e e\);
\item \(\mathsf O_2=0\): the complete rank-two standard source is eligible.
\end{enumerate}
On the rank-one branch the metric matching-axis residual vanishes identically:
\[
 \boxed{
 e^*P^*G_APe
 -\frac{|e^*G_APe|^2}{e^*G_Ae}=0.}
\]
Thus the Einstein coefficient line is reconstructed from the physical panels;
it is not selected externally.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Because every summand in \(\mathsf O_d\) is positive, a vector belongs to its
kernel exactly when
\(\mathsf R_{\rm sel}^{1/2}P^nx=0\) for \(0\le n<d\).  Cayley--Hamilton
expresses every higher power of \(P\) as a linear combination of these powers,
so the same condition holds for all \(n\ge0\).  The resulting space is
\(P\)-invariant and lies in \(\Ker\mathsf R_{\rm sel}\).  Conversely every
\(P\)-invariant subspace in that kernel is annihilated by every summand, proving
maximality.  In dimension two the rank alternatives are exhaustive.  An
invariant one-dimensional space is an eigenspace, and substitution of
\(Pe=\lambda_e e\) gives the final identity.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Canonical residual quotient and feed alternative]
\label{thm:SMST-Einstein-residual-quotient}
Let \(K=K_{\rm Ein}^{\rm std}\).  Since \(K\) is \(P\)-invariant, there is a
canonical exact sequence
\[
 \boxed{0\longrightarrow K\longrightarrow E_3
        \longrightarrow E_3/K\longrightarrow0,}
\]
and a unique induced residual propagator
\[
 \boxed{\overline P[x]=[Px].}
\]
Let \(Q_K\) be the \(G_A\)-orthogonal projection onto \(K\), and put
\[
 \boxed{
 F_{\rm feed}=Q_KP(I-Q_K),
 \qquad
 \Delta_{\rm feed}=\|F_{\rm feed}\|_{\HS,G_A}^2.}
\]
Then
\[
 \boxed{
 \Delta_{\rm feed}=0
 \iff Q_KP=PQ_K
 \iff K^{\perp_{G_A}}\text{ is }P\text{-invariant}.}
\]
The zero branch is an orthogonal direct sum of an Einstein source and an
autonomous residual SM/provenance source.  On the positive branch the same
canonical subspace and quotient exist, but the coefficient dynamics is a

\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Invariance of \(K\) makes the quotient map well defined and gives the unique
induced operator.  The lower-left block of \(P\) relative to
\(K\oplus K^{\perp_{G_A}}\) vanishes by invariance; the upper-right block is
\(F_{\rm feed}\).  It vanishes exactly when the orthogonal complement is also
invariant, equivalently when the orthogonal projection commutes with \(P\).
\end{proof}


\begin{assessment}[Exact assumption reduction and remaining physical inputs]
\label{assess:SMST-assumption-removal}
On the literal selected-phase/locked-edge/common-generator branch, the finite
source now derives:
\[
 \boxed{
 \begin{gathered}
 \text{matter occurrence}\Longrightarrow\text{weak CAR and incidence}\\
 \Longrightarrow\text{one endpoint generation triplet}\\
 \Longrightarrow\text{a nonzero admissible finite-Dirac component}
 \end{gathered}}
\]
If the odd provenance residual vanishes, the complete odd generator is the

scalar doublet.  Separate grading bridges, fair score bits, four incidence
matrices, a generation source, five unrelated Yukawa inputs, a marked
one-insertion panel, and a finite SM--normal router are unnecessary.

There is also an independent normal--Clifford entrance.  Once the locked
pre-central grading and the external Clifford axes are represented on one
same-history carrier, one positive uniform Clifford-twirl scalar decides
matter occurrence.  Its zero branch is the explicit grading supported wholly
in the normal multiplicity commutant; its maximal branch is intrinsic
Clifford chirality.  A specifically spatial SM route is decided by the spatial
three-axis subbank, or follows from the uniform scalar above its sharp
threshold.  This alternative does not infer the relative grading from
separate sign and normal marginals.

The literal locked cylinder additionally reconstructs the complete readable
private-provenance subpanel from twenty-four real aggregate--tail statistics.
The orbit-polytope inequalities are necessary and sufficient for positivity;
the weighted source blocks determine the provenance rank, unique dressed
propagator, null innovation, Schur innovation, and contractivity margin.  On
the homogeneous private branch this is exactly the finite-SM multiplicity
propagator.  If its standard multiplicity has rank two, at most one coefficient
line can coincide with one chronological spacetime standard source; the
orthogonal triplet cannot be counted twice.

Exact finite-time coherence is also unnecessary.  A differentiated
forward/reverse CPTP pair through the identity has a canonical projection onto

second-order noise is suppressed by Klein refocusing.  The direct branch uses

the bracket branch uses the optimal \(O(\sqrt h)\) time and requires

compiled channel then exports the same typed occurrence packets and relative

The remaining finite questions are source values rather than missing

record-fibre residual or, more generally, by equality of the grading
