\section{Conclusion}
\label{sec:conclusion}
% =============================================================================

The microscopic Renewal Grand Tensor is now organized around an austere
operational-predictive entrance rather than a preassembled coherent carrier.
The language-forming datum is a fixed typed event grammar.  Its surviving
semantic rows are actual occurrence, complete contextual prediction, protected
orientation, and absolute physical calibration.  Complete future equivalence
of raw histories derives the unique minimal persistent predictive carrier
before any ledger or state space is supplied.  Relative to the fixed audit
category, the four semantic rows have cofinally natural separating pairs;
orientation may be bundled only into section-complete occurrence, and residual
calibration is the finite quotient $\mathcal K_L^{\rm phys}$.  The result is a
relative primitive-basis closure theorem, not an assertion of absolute
metaphysical minimality.

At each finite cutoff this austere entrance may be compiled into the typed table
of preparations, interventions, terminal Reads, and their multitime
probabilities, together with positivity, causality, normalization, and the
protocol-generated labels that later operations are allowed to read.  The
protected record contains only such independently generated operational facts.
It contains no arithmetic coefficient, metric, gauge group, particle species,
Yukawa matrix, chain equivalence, resource lower bound, or conjecture truth
value.

The predictive core is reconstructed twice at compatible levels.  The
history-future quotient is the unique minimal deterministic predictive relation
state, while the record-conditioned Hankel quotient is its unique minimal
linear realization.  The positive causal comb reconstructs a support-minimal
sequential CP realization up to record-fixing memory unitaries.  The complete reduced core--record word maps then
generate the process-history $C^*$-algebra.  Quotienting its contextual future
radical removes precisely the histories invisible to every admitted future,
while protected label Reads prevent distinct record values from being
identified.  Central source ideals and finite separating Read panels are
therefore consequences of the operational table rather than hidden completeness
assumptions.

The finite proof-object layer now obeys the same discipline.  An executable
command distinguishes a proved branch, an exact obstruction, an unresolved
strict margin, and an ill-typed input; the last is not a theorem.  Radii and
floors are checked in their declared sign domains, and singular elimination is
performed only after the actual Moore--Penrose support and its range incidence
have been reconstructed.  This prevents a submitted projection from hiding a
kernel coupling.  The complete finite semantics has been replayed on one
frozen corpus by three exact-rational stacks with agreement on all $3392$
conclusions and explicit mutation and runtime checks.  That result is
corpus-relative and trust-profile dependent; it neither proves universal
software correctness nor supplies physical occurrence.

The canonical structural Grand Tensor is the normalized regular-trace hierarchy
\[
 \boldsymbol{\mathbb T}^{\min,op}_{\Grand,X}
 =\bigl(\mathcal A_X^{\rm hist},
        \{\mathbb K^{\rm op}_{X,r}\}_{r\ge0},
        \mathfrak R_X^{\rm op}\bigr).
\]
This is the exact structural shadow
$\boldsymbol{\mathbb T}_{\Grand,X}^{\rm old}$ of the original Store process.
The physically complete object adopted in this version is instead
\[
 \boxed{
 \boldsymbol{\mathbb T}_{\Grand,X}^{\rm rel}
 =\operatorname{GT}\!\left(
   \mathsf P_X^{\rm old}\ltimes\mathfrak P_X^{\rm rel,min}
 \right),}
\]
retained together with its old--detail polarization tables.  Its predictive
state is the derived history-future quotient.  The physical port supplies a
same-cut realization of that class together with the old $A_3$ root outcome,
the scheduler-separated fast path, protected orientation and calibration, the
same-history field/action marks, and the next readable state; forgetting the
enrichment returns the structural shadow exactly.  Its Gram kernel is exactly the
word-relation ideal.  Finite dimensionality
forces a flat depth, at which one stabilized panel reconstructs the object
units, involution, multiplication, protected record algebra, every conditional
predictive core algebra, and all represented mixed histories.  A faithful
physical future metric is a positive congruence of this intrinsic hierarchy and
therefore changes conditioning but not the reconstructed algebra.  The
Radon--Nikodym block $B_X^*G_XB_X$ is its degree-one physical Store shadow.


The relation with noncommutative geometry is now equally precise.  The
structural history algebra and regular trace determine the canonical GNS
carrier but not a Dirac scale.  Once a same-history tangent descends through the
word relations and passes the bimodule, Leibniz, star, occurrence, and
calibration audits, its universal one-form Gram gives a canonical real even
finite spectral triple.  On stationary renewal graphs, the geometric
Hodge--Dirac square is minus twice the symmetric generator and its commutator
norm is the pointwise carr\'e-du-champ norm.  The flat and de~Sitter $A_3$ Connes
distances converge to the independently reconstructed slice metrics.  The map
is many-to-one: a $b_1(G)$-dimensional current polytope, and more generally
commutant anchors and retained provenance, may be invisible spectrally.  In the
marked strong compact category this spectral quotient is essentially
surjective; in the strict norm-monoidal category it selects the spectrally
quasidiagonal subclass.  The geometric Dirac, internal finite Dirac, and OS
Hamiltonian remain distinct operators linked only by explicit product and
physical-incidence theorems.

The finite loaded relation is now equally explicit.  One completely assembled
same-history Euclidean coefficient, physical reflection, nonnegative covariance,
exterior word tower, OS-null marked descent, and local zero-safe Berezin packet
reconstruct a unique source-minimal finite Euclidean/OS carrier; the projective
full-coupling regulator makes this branch nonempty.  The terminal NCG audit does
not stop there.  Its next row asks for a calibrated antisymmetric
forward/reflected channel germ on the same represented operation algebra and
for equality of its Hamiltonian with the landed coefficient.  The available
reversible field generator supplies the symmetric OS Hamiltonian, not that
inner derivation.  A fixed noncentral query therefore returns the exact
rank-one first missing source and blocks every later line or continuum row from
being used as a substitute.

Direct interference has been separated from structural emergence.  Diagonal CP
histories do not determine a laboratory fringe; positive off-diagonal Choi
blocks are parameterized by contractions between the corresponding supports.
The Store--score writer and two-phase polarization formula remain exact and
useful when their coherent controls and fringe settings are physically present,
but they are optional realization data rather than axioms defining the Grand

completion, while the path labels remain explicit until an actual physical
erasure or future-nullity theorem is supplied.


The same discipline now governs signed coherence.  A complete cross-record
source kernel reconstructs the linear source atlas, but the coarsest
source-sufficient record, the stabilized word algebra, and the independently
physical transport are successively stronger data.  Their exact residuals
separate source hidden inside record fibres, missing word or occurrence
coordinates, transport-incidence failure, minimum demand action, open boundary
current, and internal cycle current.  The coherent/counterflow decomposition
is performed only after the relevant nuisance and cycle shorts.  A positive

or flat orientation without a physical law.  Congruence-invariant inertia and
rank--trace estimates supply an additional population or threshold-index
certificate; they do not determine a protected phase or a canonical residual

Beyond one cutoff, a globally consistent cylinder process now derives the

Global recurrence and cofinal escape are now resolved by a separate

The source balance is now canonical when an actual stock is present: its

The predictive and compactness interfaces have also been completed in the
correct order.  The future-sufficient predictor is first enlarged, when
necessary, to the minimum carrier reducing the physical action.  Future depth
and action-context depth are then assembled on one rectangular source table;
the mixed corner, reveal-order secant, and physical stopping front are retained

before the genuine remote first-return law is formed.  The remaining escape is

and exponential first-return transform are equivalent or complementary finite

Part~I-C then separates algebraic saturation from quantitative and geometric
control.  Simultaneously shorted connected panels reconstruct the intrinsic
interaction hypergraph and its operational collars; feedback is classified by

and determining variances complete the audit.  The mature universal theorem is
therefore an unconditional certification-or-obstruction alternative.  It
defines and detects the controlled positive continuum branch without asserting

The locality coordinate is now equally explicit.  A physical metric block
carrier and its weighted Schur algebra distinguish operator-norm control from
exponential spatial decay.  Source-relative leakage Grams test endpoint

responses; split-insertion paths test route locality; and local counterterm

These structures pass to the OS quotient only after null-ideal descent,
product closure, and weighted cutoff transport.  Thus finite holomorphy or
bounded commutators are no longer used as surrogates for quasilocality.

On the active Standard-Model branch the finite population problem is now
resolved into named, noninterchangeable gates and one explicit positive
sequence.  The RPESM regulator extends the compact field shell to a quartically
controlled unbounded full-coupling cylinder, equips it with a stationary
reflected Markov--Renewal path and Green operator, and transports its static,

marks, direct locality/connected panels, and one-action Ward/current/stress

weighted endpoint and route locality, contact/product/null descent, supported

Historical realization by the old Store is a separate reuse theorem.

The obstruction alternative is now typed rather than summarized by one scalar
gap.  A physical packet first exposes its loading and assembly residuals; a
complete writer atlas then separates source invisibility from a visible soft
mode; the canonical threshold screen isolates the exceptional sector; and the

the full physical law is retained whenever nonlinear, positivity, or other
observable rows can still see the discarded directions.

The positive branch now has a sharper spatial, variational, and memory
realization.  Canonical pressure demands identify the global three-dimensional
cut constant with a minimum-congestion current problem; the same margin yields
Sobolev and Poincar\'e coercivity, Weyl-type low-energy counting, and compact
screens.  Face- and period-closed directional histories integrate into
protected coordinate charts, while interface-capacity residuals detect
macroscopic necks.  Protected vector rewards on a marked renewal cycle define

After exact memory subtraction, binary renewal divisibility forces a linear
Palatini--Holst face score, connection stationarity controls torsion, and
potential and counterterm forces are exactness statements.  Hodge-dominated
loaded feedback is compact and resolves, at every fixed physical scale, into

The accepted/common-action comparison is likewise organized by its minimum
operational state rather than by an arbitrarily chosen coarse field.  The
initial comparison quotient is canonical.  On the output side, the
likelihood-ratio quotient is minimal when the initial comparison class remains
available, whereas the projective-column experiment quotient is minimal when

Finite future and Krylov saturation then reconstruct the minimum states for

the Mori--Zwanzig kernel and resolvent self-energy rather than an unnamed

occupation times, and directed jump counts, and its coarse chain rule exposes

additive rewards give finite Feynman--Kac matrices, Perron SCGFs and
large-deviation rates.  Their Doob transforms are the unique stationary
entropy-optimal dynamics realizing exposed rare currents.  These statements
are downstream compilers: they do not supply the actual accepted kernel,

Finite-time dynamical claims are now compressed at the same target-relative
level.  A selected scalar may be carried by one calibrated Read; a closed
writer bank by a positive state and derived current; one weak response by a
projectively coherent finite-query thread; and all admissible weak responses
by a compact relation.  Occupation laws, branch probabilities, and path laws
are retained only when support, probabilistic, or chronological semantics are

by an arbitrary deterministic selector and prevents the barycenter of a
solution law from being asserted to satisfy a nonlinear field equation.
Structure-preserving finite schemes, energy barriers, Fortin consistency, and
target-specific compactness provide one constructive route to the response

weighted form family, pair rectangle, split route, contact-tail audit, local
word/product/null packet, supported inverse floor, connected writer, Green
analyser, line packet, and adjacent-cutoff ledger.  Failure of any row returns
its own hopping, negative-word, divisor/sign, long-route, contact-tail,
inverse-floor, charge/flux, or cutoff witness rather than reopening the finite
SM representation or classical action.

The returning-memory ambiguity has also been reduced to a terminating finite
decision.  On a positive reflected branch, one conditional action-response
writer and $M_0^\Gamma,M_1^\Gamma,M_2^\Gamma$ first decide whether the present
temporal head reduces the transfer or return its exact source-minimal
extension.  On the complete future-visible quotient, the symmetric action and
process circulation are then reconstructed from one common forward/reflected
law.  The observability hierarchy either yields a sampled-loss or Lyapunov
decay certificate, or returns the exact invariant undamped sector.  A symmetric
Schur null is not promoted before this audit, and a validated approximate
Lyapunov solve is sufficient.  The remaining physical task is to populate and
transport the accepted/reflected law, common-action incidence, three-cylinder,
and, where necessary, $S/A$ packets; no additional internal or spacetime
primitive is presently indicated.

For the weaker existential continuum target, the response carrier is smaller
still.  One-sided compact finite-query cylinders already possess an inverse-
limit branch without fibrewise surjectivity, and their stable images give the
canonical maximum indefinitely extendible packet.  A single exact or summably
coherent thread, together with a continuation modulus and the complete finite
weak-test core, therefore proves one response.  Complete response graphs,
all-branch extension, and branch probabilities are retained only when those
stronger semantics are claimed.

The common Standard-Model--Yang--Mills frontier is similarly more specific.
The colour action and configuration carrier are already present.  The first
missing dynamic row is one physical full-coupling slab.  On its positive Doob
branch, the direct conditional action writer and three lag matrices are the
minimal first temporal packet; when only source-labelled response means are
available, a frame of dimension
$d_\Gamma=\dim\operatorname{aff}\mathcal Z_\Gamma$ supplies the affine fallback.
The stronger selector odds are retained only for law-level or nonlinear
claims.  This finite landing does not replace the weak-coupling ultraviolet/
infrared and Osterwalder--Schrader estimates.

The numerical layer now obeys the same separation discipline.  Executable
neighbouring laws reconstruct a normalized score localizer only after their
scores descend through the returned-word relations and every nuisance and
extension direction has been assembled on one cylinder.  The completeness of
the returned-word carrier is no longer assumed: every physical one-letter
extension is tested by its Schur innovation, positive innovations append only
their polar banks, the first zero innovation must satisfy the flat action
relations and a held-out word, and the enlarged localizer has an exact
floor-or-soft certificate.  On a positive reflected subsector, the conditional
action writer and its first three lag Grams additionally close or enlarge the
temporal action head before the source-cyclic localizer is diagonalized.  Only
then is finite word flatness followed by source-cyclic localizer saturation;
the latter alone licenses a global floor or kernel.  The constant kernel is
then split by future visibility
and by its Feshbach-corrected width jets.  Matrix-valued writers reconstruct the
physical ordered cone and its compact calibrated base, while the complete
quadratic shell and source forcing determine a projective ray.  A contraction
residual gives a certified scalar interval, but the absolute partition,
volume, direct-action, determinant/Pfaffian modulus, and phase remain separate
measure rows.  This is the precise operational boundary between structural
emergence and numerical prediction.

The manuscript therefore separates canonical finite emergence,
universal certification, branch selection, stochastic forcing, deterministic
mean dynamics, quantum measure provenance, numerical calibration, and uniform
analytic control at every stage.
\end{assessment}
